A token directly after was/is/were/seemed/felt gains about +0.2-0.3 of max, so most adjectives there (angry 0.8, cold, tall, calm) reach 0.3-0.6. It stays below 0.2 of max on colour words (also after 'was'), big/long/large, time words (today, Monday, morning, week), place nouns (city, park, church, office), kinship nouns (mother, father, brother), everyday objects (car, book, door, house, wall, stone), activity verbs (reading, running, working, driving), joy/pride/trial/verdict, small counts two/three/seven and digit counts ('12 eggs'), function words and code; animals and some objects (ball, chair, cat, floor) are unclaimed at 0.2-0.4.
